mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions at Reddan Soccer Park are 32 degrees and clear, with the moon in a waning crescent phase.

Public works crews are preparing for asphalt repairs on November 10 and 11. Work will take place on North Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, Mozart Street, Todd Street, Edward Street, and near Hemlock Drive, so please observe no parking signs between 7 AM and 7 PM.

You have plenty to do this weekend. Today, enjoy the Dane County Farmers Market at the Square, plus live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, catch more live music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On October 25, officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, where they arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for O W I after he was discovered unresponsive behind the wheel.
Today's flavor of the day is the Andes Mint Avalanche. The store is currently closed, but it will open today at 10:00 AM for you to enjoy your treat.
